title: The Fisherman and his Soul
description: A young fisherman nets a little mermaid and loves her. To go down to her he must send his soul away — and the soul goes into the world without a heart, wearing his face. Every choice is between the one he loves and the one he was.
line: To love her wholly he cuts away his soul — and the soul learns from the world without a heart.
source: after the fairy tale by Oscar Wilde
